sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: pedestrians, school buses, emergency vehicles and traffic stops
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The first page of this range finishes the pickup-bed rule from the previous section; its exemptions and fine were kept here because they appear on this page [A01].
The school bus diagrams carry the road-layout rules as captions on the emergency-vehicle page; each caption was turned into its own fact on that page [A03].
The section title in the run map mentions funerals, but no funeral procession rule appears on the selected pages; nothing about funerals was stated.
The figures for school bus mileage and riders were not used because they are descriptive and not rules.
Traffic-stop guidance mixes legal duties (identification, weapon disclosure, the misdemeanor for obstruction) with advice; the facts keep the stated legal duties as duties and the rest as advice.

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.
